text:
deadlock: 3 agents wait on each other in a cycle and none can move:
  api (devin-82d9564addb9498b9353c5c19d484608) -> waits on auth (devin-d1bfef504ce340f5b7952aff195a6be4) for 12s: its HTTP interface (the /login route shape)
  auth (devin-d1bfef504ce340f5b7952aff195a6be4) -> waits on db (devin-a1a52cb3dec643cea721ee8cb97fcca9) for 9s: the users migration
  db (devin-a1a52cb3dec643cea721ee8cb97fcca9) -> waits on api (devin-82d9564addb9498b9353c5c19d484608) for 7s: approval of the users schema
Every one of them is alive and healthy; the cycle is why nothing happens.
Break it: pick one edge and resolve it from outside (give the approval yourself, drop the dependency, reorder the work, or stop one agent). To stop one: `agsv send <id> "stop: ..."` then check it in Devin.
